mapper.insert: MERGE INTO CLIENT_PERFORM M USING ( SELECT TO_CHAR(#{dYearMonth, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'YYMM') AS YEARMONTH, #{client_No} AS CLIENT_NO, #{total_Amt} AS AMT FROM DUAL ) SRC ON (M.YEARMONTH = SRC.YEARMONTH AND M.CLIENT_NO = SRC.CLIENT_NO) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (YEARMONTH, CLIENT_NO, CNT, TOTAL_AMT) VALUES (SRC.YEARMONTH, SRC.CLIENT_NO, 1, SRC.AMT) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET M.CNT = NVL(M.CNT,0) + 1, M.TOTAL_AMT = NVL(M.TOTAL_AMT,0) + SRC.AMT
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CLIENT_PERFORM WHERE YEARMONTH = TO_CHAR(#{dYearMonth, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 'YYMM') AND CLIENT_NO = #{client_No} AND NVL(CNT,0) <= 0 AND NVL(TOTAL_AMT,0) <= 0
